title: On Ramanujan's $q$-Continued Fractions of Order Thirty-Four and Sixty-Eight
summary: We derived $q$-continued fractions $X_i(q)$ of order thirty-four and continued fractions $Y_i(q)$ of order sixty-eight from a general continued fraction identity of Ramanujan, where $i=1,2,3,4,5,6,7$ and $8$. We established some theta-function identities, and one has been proved for the continued fractions $X_i(q)$ and $Y_i(q)$. Furthermore, we obtained results on vanishing coefficients arising from these continued fractions and their reciprocals. As an application of the theta-function identities for $Y_i(q)$, we derived certain color partition identities.
